convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for TriXCandle indicator and depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for position sizing, order execution, and position management functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory). These custom dependencies require manual reconstruction in Python.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - seconds per indicator timeframe bar
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for position open timing

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation

other_exits: BuyPosClose and SellPosClose are controlled by boolean input flags BuyPosClose/SellPosClose, allowing independent disable of signal-based exit

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum determines sizing: LOT=fixed lots, FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. The MM input value interpretation changes based on MMMode selection.

custom_logic_notes: The EA reads buffer index 4 from the TriXCandle custom indicator. TrendValue is an array of 2 values copied from buffer 4 starting at SignalBar. TrendValue[1] is the current signal bar value, TrendValue[0] is the next older bar. Long signal fires when TrendValue[1]==2 and TrendValue[0]<2 (transition to bullish state). Short signal fires when TrendValue[1]==0 and TrendValue[0]>0 (transition to bearish state). Entry/exit are independently toggleable via BuyPosOpen, SellPosOpen, BuyPosClose, SellPosClose booleans. The UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime is set to last bar date + TimeShiftSec, likely used by TradeAlgorithms library for order expiration or timing. A static Recount flag forces signal recalculation on first tick or after CopyBuffer failure. LoadHistory is called each tick to ensure bar data availability.
python_conversion_notes: The TriXCandle custom indicator must be reverse-engineered or reimplemented in Python - it is the core signal source reading from buffer 4 with values 0, 1, 2 representing bearish/neutral/bullish states. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, and LoadHistory - all must be reimplemented. The margin mode logic (5 modes) from TradeAlgorithms.mqh needs careful porting. SL/TP values of 1000/2000 points are large suggesting they may already be in points (not pips) or this targets a high-volatility instrument. No digit adjustment logic is present in the EA itself, but the TradeAlgorithms library may handle it internally. Signal logic is straightforward: discrete state transitions on the TriXCandle indicator buffer.
